purpose: Pre-registered market-failure / selectivity regimes. FROZEN before any ATS result was computed. Discovery only — no picks, no deployment.

signConventions.realized_ats: actual_margin - market_implied_home_margin ; >0 HOME covered, <0 AWAY covered, =0 push
signConventions.disagreement_signal: modelOrFeatureImpliedHomeMargin - market_implied_home_margin ; >0 => signal thinks HOME undervalued => betSign=+1

aprioriConstants.note: Standard published constants (Elo ~25 pts/point; HFA ~2.5). Fixed a priori, never fit to these data. HFA applied to rating/form-implied margins only when NOT a neutral site; market already embeds HFA.

regimeFamilies.rationale: Classic hypothesis: public overvalues heavy favorites.
Direct complement of fade_large_favorites (tests the opposite direction so we never assume which way inefficiency runs).

regimeFamilies.filter: market_implied_home_margin <= -T (home is a dog by >= T)
market_implied_home_margin >= T (away is a dog by >= T)

regimeFamilies.rationale: Pregame Elo disagrees with the market line.

regimeFamilies.signal: count of {elo,sp,fpi,form} implied margins that disagree with market in the SAME direction with abs>=1; betSign = that agreed direction
regimeFamilies.betRule: qualify only when >= K families agree; betSign = agreed sign
regimeFamilies.rationale: Inefficiency should be most credible where multiple independent leakage-safe families agree against the market.

regimeFamilies.appliedTo: ALL 6 persisted (model,family) combos, each counted as its own hypothesis family
regimeFamilies.rationale: Frozen Phase 5 models' own disagreement, re-examined selectively.

contextConditioners.note: Applied ONLY to the single best-surviving directional family as a secondary concentration probe, NOT crossed against everything (keeps hypothesis count bounded).

selectivityGrid.rule: Percentile cutoff of |signal| computed on PRIOR test seasons only, then applied unchanged to the next test season. Reports how ATS changes as selectivity tightens.

walkForward.note: Phase 5 folds produced OOS predictions for these test seasons. Fixed-threshold regimes use NO fitting (defined a priori) so pooled OOS is already leakage-safe; percentile selectivity uses prior-seasons-only cutoffs. 2020 always reported both included and excluded.

multipleComparison.rawTest: two-sided exact binomial vs efficient-market null p=0.5 on decided bets
multipleComparison.profitabilityBar: pooled ATS win% point estimate AND Wilson-95 lower bound must exceed 52.38%

robustness.concentration: re-test any promising regime after removing (a) its single best team, (b) its single best conference
robustness.neighborhood: vary the driving threshold to neighbors; a real effect must not live at a single magic cutoff and should trend, not spike

classificationStandard.PROMISING_BUT_UNPROVEN: survives multiple seasons + robustness but not yet deployment-grade
classificationStandard.STRONG_CANDIDATE: survives walk-forward + neighbors + team/conference concentration + multiple-comparison correction AND clears profitability bar

hardRules: No pick generation. No deployment. No modification of Phase 1-6 artifacts.
No regime may use the target test season's ATS results to define itself or choose a threshold.
Sign-convention assertions must pass before any regime is scored.
